sources.note: snapshot_download supports pinned revision and filtered file download patterns
offline Transformers requires downloaded/cached files ahead of time
headers can be parsed cheaply without full tensor loading
exact IO-aware attention is a baseline pressure for sparse claims
compiled flexible attention masks reduce the novelty/performance moat for custom variants
KV-cache memory management is a required serving baseline
KV eviction/heavy-hitter methods are a required efficient-memory baseline
dynamic sparse attention for long-context prefill is a required sparse baseline

interpretation: External pressure supports CloudtainerML’s phase separation and raises the bar for performance promotion: sparse wins must survive modern exact attention, compiled mask support, KV-cache systems, and dynamic sparse long-context baselines.
